page.overview:
What is Holier Than Thou?

Holier Than Thou is the third track from Metallica's self-titled album, Metallica (also known as the "Black Album").

The title of Holier Than Thou describes a self-righteous attitude where a person thinks they are better than others, acting like they are more moral or pious. It shows disapproval of someone who suggests they are more religious or virtuous than everyone else. The saying comes from the Bible (Isaiah 65:5), which talks about people who say, "Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou".

The song itself is against arrogance, judgement, and hypocrisy, such as judgemental religious figures or critics who project false moral superiority. The lyrics focus on rejecting control and maintaining personal freedom against those who manipulate others while pretending to be perfect.

No more! The crap rolls out your mouth again Haven't changed, your brain is still gelatin Little whispers circle around your head Why don't you worry about yourself instead?
